The core philosophy explores the vital distinction between our temporary physique and the eternal flame of the soul. As Osho writes, "Man is not merely a lamp made of clay; in him also resides a flame of light that constantly rises towards the sun... Only his body is made of clay; his soul is that flame."

Through these pages, you will be guided to discard the "smoke from your mind" and see the true flame of consciousness. *   **Modern Relevance:** The teachings are highly adaptable, offering guidance on integrating profound spirituality into the daily challenges of modern living.
